summary: Examples test whether /etc/hosts is a directory and reject directories from a list of paths.
questions: How do I drop directories from a path list?

answer_card.title: is_dir test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  my_etc_hosts_not_a_dir: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is directory }}"
  list_of_files: "{{ list_of_paths | reject('directory') }}"
```
